criterion_fired: Criterion 1 (Metrics), Criterion 3 (Evidence Quality), Criterion 4 (Actionable Next Steps), Criterion 5 (Unsupported Claims)
suggested_change: Criterion 1: Define score bands explicitly (e.g., 7-10 = specific metrics present, 4-6 = partial metrics, 1-3 = no quantifiable data). Criterion 3: Require minimum threshold of direct quotes vs. paraphrasing; fail if source material is corrupted/unusable. Criterion 4: Define 'actionable' as requiring [person] + [day/date] + [specific question/task], reject 'schedule X call' without temporal specificity. Criterion 5: Prohibit champion claims without explicit evidence of proactive advocacy behavior in transcript.
